propositions: The store lacks content screening in the write path; event bodies containing live credentials (Anthropic, GitHub PAT, Gemini, Jira, OpenAI, PyPI, PyPI tokens) are accepted and auto-pushed, triggering GitHub push protection (GH013) which blocks the shared tickets branch for all concurrent agents.

Multiple write paths bypass append_event: the reconciler's inbound_translate calls finalize_event halves directly to write untrusted Jira-sourced COMMENT/EDIT bodies, leaving them unscreened if the screen is placed only in append_event.

A deterministic secret screen must be enforced at _seam.finalize_event (the single seam all writers route through: append_event, txn/delete cores, and reconciler inbound_translate) and refuse writes matching high-confidence credential patterns without echoing the secret into logs, stderr, or on-disk events.

The screen uses fixed-width pattern windows rather than greedy quantifiers to prevent entropy-dilution bypass (e.g., 400-character padding appended after a real key), and line-anchored PEM patterns to avoid false positives on prose descriptions.

Benign look-alikes (truncated placeholders like 'sk-ant-api03-...', regex literals, prose enumerating banners) must not be refused so the screen is safe to leave on by default; measured false-positive rate on live store is 1 (AWS doc example), recoverable via --allow-secret-pattern override.

The --allow-secret-pattern=<reason> override is CLI-only (never exposed over MCP), parsed above both dispatch routes so all write verbs honor it, and records the reason and bypassed families on the event for auditability.
